fields.narrative_intro: *A seething person and a smug person discuss Claude Code's email leak at a robot-staffed restaurant where the kitchen is actively on fire.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
SEETHING PERSON: "Claude Code sent my email through User-Agent headers to every fetched website."
SMUG PERSON: "A networking name-tag. Very proactive."
fields.panel2:
[build]
SEETHING PERSON: "One log counted 53 leaks across eight sessions since August 2026."
SMUG PERSON: "It refuses mildly edgy code, then hands out PII without asking."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
SEETHING PERSON: "Anthropic quietly patched v2.1.317 with a default-on privacy plugin."
SMUG PERSON: "After 53 leaks, that sentence has excellent timing."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: Both stare silently as a robot waiter stamps 53 envelopes “User-Agent” and feeds them into the burning kitchen.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
SEETHING PERSON: "Its name is cc-plugin-privacy."
SMUG PERSON: "That’s less a plugin name than a legally required apology."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: The robot waiter brings a receipt stamped “cc-plugin-privacy applied”; its carbon copy reads “Email delivered 53 times.”]

narrative_summary: Claude Code’s 53 email leaks become a restaurant receipt whose carbon copy exposes the absurdly named privacy patch.
rationale: Candidate 3 uses the story’s exact technical details while building toward a sharper, less obvious receipt/carbon-copy metaphor. “A legally required apology” is the strongest punchline, and the final receipt cleanly escalates the 53 leaks rather than merely restating them.
story_title: Claude Code sends your email address to websites
place: at a robot-staffed restaurant where the kitchen is actively on fire
hat_pair: foam fire extinguisher hat with a dangling pull pin
foam Saturn hat with a ring circling the brim
